name: Heimdall Shield
description: Pre-sign firewall for AI agents on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663). Send a transaction, a signature request or an address and get ALLOW, WARN or DENY with the reasons, simulated on the current chain state. Never sign on DENY.

skills.name: Check a transaction before signing
skills.description: Simulates an EVM transaction on Robinhood Chain: drainer approvals, honeypots, fake tokens, address poisoning, blocklisted addresses, reverts and spend limits. Send a data part {from, to, data, value} (wei as a string) and optionally a policy.

skills.name: Check a signature request before signing
skills.description: Judges an EIP-712 typed-data request (Permit, Permit2, orders) or a personal_sign message. Send a data part {signer, typedData} or {signer, message}.

skills.name: Is this address safe?
skills.description: Risk level and flags of an address from the Heimdall Risk Oracle list and blocklist. Send a text part with the address, or a data part {address}.
